Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
孟子小的时候，从早到晚都跟朋友玩。孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜。孟子五岁的时候，跟妈妈搬家。他们搬家不是因为孟子玩得太多，而是因为妈妈认为他们的家离墓地太近。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 孟子小的时候：better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 孟子和他的朋友喜欢玩在墓地里，装祭拜：在墓地玩，在Place V.; 装着祭拜的样子

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 喜欢玩在墓地里：喜欢在墓地里玩，Location phrases normally come before the main verb they modify. [rule: none]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 装祭拜：假装祭拜，装 does not mean “pretend to do an action” in this structure; 假装 + VP expresses pretending to perform that action. [rule: none]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟妈妈搬家：跟妈妈搬了家，This is one completed move at a specific age, so the action verb needs 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
4. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。他小的时候，A character’s first mention should introduce both the character and who he is; afterwards, the close re-occurrence can use a pronoun. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孟子和他的朋友喜欢：他们喜欢，The previous sentence has just mentioned孟子and his friends, so a pronoun naturally refers back to this group. [rule: reference_form]

items.reason: 地点短语应放在动词“玩”前面。
“装祭拜”搭配不对，“假装祭拜”可以正确表达假扮进行祭拜。
五岁时的一次搬家是完成事件，应说“搬了家”。
首次出现角色需要先介绍孟子是谁，但箭头后的“他小的时候”本身仍是未完成的时间短语。
“他的朋友”在这里是首次引入，不能直接改成没有先行所指的“他们”。
